questions.question: In digital electronics, what does the acronym FPGA stand for?
options: Field-Programmable Gate Array
Fast Processing Global Architecture
Frequency-Phase Gate Alliance
Flexible Peripheral Gated Array
Fundamental Programmed Gate Algorithm

questions.question: In a modern pipelined CPU architecture, what is the primary role of a Branch Predictor?
options: To accelerate floating-point arithmetic operations
To manage cache memory coherence between multiple cores
To estimate the likely outcome of a conditional branch instruction before it is fully evaluated
To perform dynamic voltage and frequency scaling
To ensure data integrity during memory transactions

questions.question: In the context of digital IC design, what is the primary goal of implementing Design for Testability (DFT) techniques?
options: To minimize the total power consumption of the chip
To improve the performance of critical timing paths
To facilitate the testing of manufactured chips for defects
To reduce the physical area occupied by the logic gates
To automatically synthesize the RTL code into a gate-level netlist

questions.question: What is the fundamental difference in how Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM) and Dynamic Random-Access Memory (DRAM) store a single bit of information?
options: SRAM uses a capacitor to store charge, while DRAM uses a flip-flop
SRAM uses a flip-flop, while DRAM uses a capacitor to store charge
SRAM uses a magnetic domain, while DRAM uses an electrical current
SRAM stores data permanently, while DRAM is volatile
SRAM is read-only, while DRAM is read-write

questions.question: In the design of high-speed arithmetic logic units (ALUs), what is the primary advantage of a Carry-Lookahead Adder (CLA) compared to a Ripple-Carry Adder (RCA)?
options: It consumes significantly less power due to fewer transistors
It requires fewer input pins for large number additions
It reduces the worst-case propagation delay by computing carry bits in parallel
It is simpler to implement in hardware due to its sequential structure
It can only perform subtraction operations efficiently
